title: Give harness-minted task records the fields the queue requires
goal: SusiTarget::add_task mints a task record without created_by and created_unix. tests/task_records.rs now pins the queue's schema (required id, title, accept.cmd, created_by, created_unix) and refuses any new record that lacks them, so every harness mission that mints its own task fails its landing gate on its own record. add_task writes both fields: the claiming worker and the time of minting.

results.change: add_task writes created_by (the claiming worker) and created_unix into the record it mints.
results.acceptance: cargo test --offline --locked -p susi-harness --lib add_task_returns_the_id_and_claim_reserves_scopes passes and now reads the minted record back; adapter suite 45 passed.
results.found: The landing gate of harness mission core-resume failed in tests/task_records.rs on its own minted record: missing field created_by.
